quote: Our data and analytics solutions, which have been developed through substantial investment over many decades, are deeply embedded into our clients’ workflow as demonstrated by our long-term client relationships, multi-year contracts and high contract renewal rates.
why: embeddedとworkflowで顧客業務への組込を断定し、multi-year contractsも挙げる。顧客側の再認定は述べず70。

quote: We believe we are able to compete favorably against other food service providers through our convenient bakery-cafe locations, environment, food and beverage quality, customer service, and price.
why: compete favorablyの根拠はlocations・quality・priceで、来店客が乗り換えで負う費用の機構は無い。

quote: The principal elements of competition for the Company’s products are product technology, distribution, quality, service and price.
why: competitionの要素がquality・service・priceという一般的な競争記述で、顧客の乗り換え費用の機構は無い。

quote: Custom manufacturing involves producing unique products for individual customers, generally under long-term contracts.
why: unique productsをlong-term contractsで供給と断定し複数年の契約拘束を名指し。購買量の義務や再認定の記述は無く70。

quote: The introduction of a VAD system in a hospital or other medical facility requires that the surgical and clinical support personnel possess certain product expertise.
why: introductionにはpersonnelのproduct expertiseが要ると断定＝病院側の再教育負担。再認定までは言わず70。

quote: Customers cancel their subscription to our service for many reasons, including a perception that they do not use the service sufficiently.
why: Customers cancelとfor many reasonsが解約の容易さを示し、顧客が負う乗り換え費用の機構は述べていない。

quote: We compete based on the breadth and quality of our data sets, the exclusive nature of some of our key data sets, the quality and effectiveness of our products and the integration of our platforms into customer systems.
why: integrationはcompete basedの競争要因の一つとして並ぶだけで乗り換え費用の断定ではなく、迷い下へ倒す。

quote: Such agreements generally contain a significant early termination fee paid by the customer.
why: early termination fee paid by the customerと途中解約の費用を顧客が負うと断定。契約の拘束で再認定ではないので70。

quote: Consolidations and acquisitions also impact our financial results due to early contract termination fees in our multi-year client contracts.
why: multi-yearの顧客契約にtermination feesがあり、途中解約の費用を顧客が負う。再認定ではなく70。

quote: The contracts are generally non-cancellable by the customer unless the Company fails to perform its obligations.
why: non-cancellable by the customerと顧客側から解約できない契約を断定。拘束の機構で再認定ではないため70。

quote: We expect that this competition will continue to intensify in the future as a result of industry consolidation, the continuing maturation of the industry and low barriers to entry.
why: competitionが激化しlow barriers to entryと自認する一般的な競争記述で、乗り換え費用の機構は無い。

quote: These customers typically do not enter into long-term contracts and make purchase decisions based on a combination of price, product quality, consumer demand and customer service performance.
why: do not enter into long-term contractsでprice等により購買を決めると明記＝顧客を縛る乗り換え費用が無い。
